explanationAr: نستخدم الماضي البسيط لحدث انتهى في وقت محدد في الماضي، مثل yesterday و last week و in 2020 و two days ago. نضيف ed إلى أغلب الأفعال: work تصبح worked، و finish تصبح finished. وهناك أفعال شاذة يجب حفظها: go → went، و write → wrote، و buy → bought، و see → saw. وانتبه إلى الإملاء: stop → stopped، و study → studied، و plan → planned. وفي النفي والسؤال نستخدم did مع الفعل في صورته الأساسية: I didn't go. Did you finish?
explanationEn: Use the past simple for a finished action at a time in the past: yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago. Add -ed to most verbs: worked, finished. Learn the irregular verbs: go → went, write → wrote, buy → bought, see → saw. Check the spelling: stopped, studied, planned. In negatives and questions, use did with the base verb: I didn't go. Did you finish?

comparison.en: I went to the site yesterday.

comparison.noteAr: بعد didn't يأتي الفعل في صورته الأساسية: finish، وليس finished.

examples.en: We started the test at nine.

exercises.explanationAr: last week تدل على الماضي، فنضيف ed: installed.

exercises.explanationAr: بعد didn't يأتي الفعل في صورته الأساسية: finish.
في stop نضاعف الحرف p قبل ed: stopped.
